summary.en: Register the name your business trades under. This is the first step for most new businesses and is a prerequisite for a trade license and business TIN.
summary.am: ንግድዎ የሚሰራበትን ስም ያስመዝግቡ። ለአብዛኛዎቹ አዳዲስ ንግዶች የመጀመሪያው እርምጃ ነው።

description.en: Search the business name registry to confirm your proposed name is not taken and not too similar to an existing registered name. Most trade offices let you check at the counter or via the federal business registry.

responsible_office.en: Trade office / federal business registry (check first)

description.en: Fill the business name application form with your details and preferred names in order of priority. Submit it with your ID. The office reserves the name once approved.
description.am: የንግድ ስም ማመልከቻ ቅጹን ይሙሉና ከመታወቂያዎ ጋር ያቅርቡ።

responsible_office.am: የንግድ ጽህፈት ቤት — የስም ምዝገባ ዴስክ

description.en: Pay the name registration fee once the name is approved. Payment is usually at a designated bank or the office cashier, and you keep the receipt as proof.
description.am: ስሙ ከጸደቀ በኋላ የምዝገባ ክፍያውን ይክፈሉ።

description.en: Return to the trade office with your payment receipt to collect the official business name registration certificate. Check the spelling of the name and your details before leaving — corrections later are slow.
description.am: የክፍያ ደረሰኝዎን ይዘው ተመልሰው የንግድ ስም ምዝገባ የምስክር ወረቀት ይቀበሉ።

responsible_office.am: የንግድ ጽህፈት ቤት — የምስክር ወረቀት ዴስክ

common_rejection_reasons.en: Name identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered business
common_rejection_reasons.am: ስሙ ከነባር ንግድ ጋር ተመሳሳይ ነው

common_rejection_reasons.en: Name contains prohibited words (e.g. government/royal references without authorization)
Incomplete application form or missing ID copy

notes.en: Name registration is handled by sub-city trade offices in Addis Ababa. Name checks and issuance are usually quick; the federal registry is used for companies (PLC/SC).
notes.am: በአዲስ አበባ የስም ምዝገባ በክፍለ ከተማ የንግድ ጽህፈት ቤቶች ይከናወናል።

notes.en: Dire Dawa has its own city administration trade office handling name registration directly.
notes.am: ድሬ ዳዋ የራሷ የንግድ ጽህፈት ቤት አላት።

responsible_office.en: Dire Dawa City Administration Trade Office
Dire Dawa City Administration Trade Office

notes.en: Handled by the Tigray Region Trade Bureau in Mekelle. Confirm current operating status before travelling.
notes.am: በመቀሌ በትግራይ ክልል የንግድ ቢሮ ይከናወናል።

responsible_office.en: Tigray Region Trade Bureau, Mekelle branch
Tigray Region Trade Bureau, Mekelle branch

notes.en: Handled by the Oromia Region Trade Bureau, Jimma branch. Name checks run against the federal registry for companies (PLC/SC).
notes.am: በጅማ በኦሮሚያ ክልል የንግድ ቢሮ ቅርንጫፍ ይከናወናል።

responsible_office.en: Oromia Region Trade Bureau, Jimma branch
Oromia Region Trade Bureau, Jimma branch

notes.en: Handled by the Amhara Region Trade Bureau, Gondar branch.
notes.am: በጎንደር በአማራ ክልል የንግድ ቢሮ ቅርንጫፍ ይከናወናል።

responsible_office.en: Amhara Region Trade Bureau, Gondar branch
